versions.changelog:
Initial release of Diagnostic-Medicine-PMPH-10edition skill collection.

- Covers 183 core clinical diagnostic skills based on the 10th edition of the PMPH Diagnostics textbook.
- Skills include medical history taking, physical exam, lab interpretation, ECG and imaging analysis, differential diagnosis, clinical reasoning, and specialty procedures.
- Provides structured skill registration table in both Chinese and English.
- Each skill links to detailed protocols or decision frameworks.
- Designed as a comprehensive digital reference for clinical diagnostics learning and practice.
